title: Patient privacy and confidentiality during dispensing and administration
rule_summary: Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124 provides that a pharmacist or pharmacy intern engaged in this activity must maintain the privacy and confidentiality of any patient to whom medication is administered, in accordance with 247 CMR 2.00 et seq., and 42 CFR Part 2 as applicable, at all times during the course of dispensing and administration.
exam_relevance: Tests that the privacy and confidentiality duty runs at all times during the course of dispensing and administration and brings in 42 CFR Part 2 as applicable.

authority.name: Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124, Pharmacist Administration of Medications, March 11, 2026

common_confusions: Assuming the duty attaches only at the moment of injection, when it runs at all times during the course of dispensing and administration.
Treating 42 CFR Part 2 as governing every administration, when the circular brings it in as applicable.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-14 in Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124, Pharmacist Administration of Medications, dated March 11, 2026, in the Word document linked from the Department's news page on mass.gov.
